statement: Let a visitor browse the captured StyleSeat client surface offline — the /m/ home, city and category professional lists, and individual professional profiles with services, gallery and reviews — and let the seeded client account sign in, see its own logged-in surface, and sign out. Every response is served from the local capture and the local backend; no remote request, no real booking, no payment. The professional-role surface is deliberately not cloned (customer ruling, recorded in known-differences.json).
out_of_scope: Professional-role login surface and every /m/pro-* route behind it (customer ruling).
Real booking, messaging and payment effects — the source was explored read-only, GET only.
The /blog surface, which is a separate third-party Webflow property.
Cities other than the locked oakland-ca for the category dimension.
